verdict.rationale: Oyster is a global employment and payroll platform, so configuring multiple pay schedules is a fair question for it. The evidence only says Oyster offers "multi-country payroll in 120+ currencies." Nothing documents setting up weekly, biweekly, semimonthly or monthly pay frequencies, or assigning different schedules to different teams.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set up multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) across different teams
